title: Steepest-descent timing in anonymous GLRT arcs
sample: 8 offers across 4 recorded captures and 2 simulations
boundary: Anonymous native arcs → replicated timing features and geometric sensitivity
note: Each root must be bracketed and reproduced on disjoint native points. The known-orbit sensitivity at generic offered sites is an optimistic comparison. All four recorded offers proceeded to a separate position attempt. The simulated offers stayed at the support gate.
